summary: Frontend-only regression for v3.0.2 responsive multi-column layout PASSED. Verified across 3 viewports (390x844 phone, 800x1280 tab7, 1200x1920 tab10). All 7 category columns are always rendered in a horizontal ScrollView. Phone shows 2 full columns (CRYPTO + ETF) with a hint of the 3rd at right edge (col width ~183px, 2 fit per screen). Tablet 7" & 10" both render all 7 columns with narrow ~178px cards (not stretched). Chip selection only highlights (opacity 1 vs 0.72) without removing columns. Search 'BTC' correctly filters to BTC + FBTC only. Language toggle ID→EN→RU→CN translates both version label ('Ver'/'Вер'/'版本') and category chips ('Crypto'/'Крипто'/'加密'). All 7 categories loaded real price data (crypto:23, etf:22, stock_id:23, stock_us:66, gold_silver:4, commodity:8, forex:12). App version confirmed 3.0.2 in version.ts and app.json.

issues: Header title is auto-shrunk further than request expected — actually renders as 'AI Cryp...' (not 'AI Crypto St...') due to 5 action buttons + login button competing for horizontal space. adjustsFontSizeToFit + numberOfLines=1 is doing its job, but readability at 390px is borderline. Consider hiding login-button text or the disclaimer icon on <400px to give the title more room.

react_native_issues.issue: Comment on line 340 says 'multi-select, max 2' and toggleCategory (lines 218-229) still enforces max 2 selections. Since chip selection now only affects opacity highlight (not filtering), the 'max 2' constraint feels arbitrary — user can't highlight >2 categories. Reference: /app/frontend/app/index.tsx:218-229 and :340.

Data state on line 158-161 initialises a `world_stocks` key that is not part of the Category/Market union (only stock_us exists). Same in loadingMap resets (lines 163-166, 181-184, 205-208) and load next-object (lines 190-193). Harmless dead field but type-unsafe. Reference: /app/frontend/app/index.tsx:158-208.

action_items: Update stale comment on index.tsx:340 ('multi-select, max 2') to reflect new highlight-only behavior.
Decide whether to keep or lift the 'max 2 selected' constraint in toggleCategory (lines 218-229) — since selection no longer filters columns, the cap may be unintuitive.
Optional: clean up dead `world_stocks` key from the data/loadingMap objects in index.tsx (not part of Market type).
Optional (design polish): the phone header title collapses to 'AI Cryp...' due to crowded action bar; consider hiding the 'LOGIN' text on narrow viewports.
critical_code_review_comments: index.tsx is 646 lines — approaching the 700-line split threshold. Consider extracting AssetCard, ListColumn, and header into separate components.

SCREEN_W is captured from Dimensions at render time (line 254); it will not react to web viewport resizes. Use useWindowDimensions() so column width recalculates on rotation/browser resize. Reference: /app/frontend/app/index.tsx:254.
